cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Drop the Armor
cards.instruction: Persuade someone to lower their guard, stop performing strength, or admit what affects them.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've heard 'I'm managing' three times over dinner. You're allowed to give me a less polished answer about going home.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's the silence. I leave the television on so it sounds occupied.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'm approving a real guest. Ask me over without pretending you've already got company.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll cook. I promise I won't be miserable all evening.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Cooking is optional; that promise is rejected. You may invite me when you're miserable and serve toast. I'd rather have your company than your performance.

reason: A grants company while rejecting the condition that B host cheerfully, turning B offered solution into a specific lowering of the guard.
